mapping_assumptions: Use observed 10Y yield change as a parallel shock to every position's signed DV01, including swaps and US/European credit; this is a proxy assumption, not the actual curve. The 2Y move is retained in both conditions as evidence of nonparallel movement.
Apply the reported S&P 500 percentage return to both US and developed ex-US equity deltas. The ex-US mapping is illustrative, not an observed ex-US return.
Apply reported EUR/USD percentage change to the synthetic long-EUR delta; no revaluation of historical forward points, carry or basis.

Set engine IG/HY shocks to zero only to omit unavailable spread contributions. Zero is not an observation of unchanged spreads. Credit-spread P&L and the all-factor historical total are unknown; reported total is a partial-factor hypothetical calculation.
Hold current synthetic positions and sensitivities fixed. They are not historical holdings. The USD 100m mark sum is a synthetic reference denominator, not a historical NAV.

facts.text: At 08:30 ET, August CPI was released: headline +0.1% month-on-month seasonally adjusted and +8.3% year-on-year unadjusted; excluding food and energy, +0.6% month-on-month and +6.3% year-on-year. Shelter, food and medical care contributed to inflation despite falling gasoline prices.

The consensus headline monthly forecast had been -0.1%. The market wrap described a reversal of prior optimism about easing inflation and a slower tightening path, with investors reassessing the Fed toward more aggressive rate increases at its upcoming meeting and worrying about recession risk. These are contemporaneous reported expectations, not a subsequent policy decision or established cause of all daily moves.
